name: Boston Light
heritage: National Historic Landmark; National Register of Historic Places listed place
text: Boston Light is a lighthouse located on Little Brewster Island in outer Boston Harbor, Massachusetts. The first lighthouse to be built on the site dates back to 1716, and was the first lighthouse to be built in what is now the United States. During the American Revolution, the original lighthouse was held by British forces and was attacked and burnt on two occasions by American forces.

depictions.name: Boston Light
depictions.text: The Boston Light was a lighthouse located in the Boston Frontier. It was the first lighthouse to be erected in North America. The lighthouse was originally built so that it could assist the ships docking into the Boston Harbor at nightfall.
